entities.name: Network slicing indication
entities.description: An information element that indicates whether the user's network slicing subscription has changed in the UDM of a PLMN or an SNPN.

entities.name: User's network slicing subscription has changed
entities.description: Condition that the user's network slicing subscription has changed in the UDM of a PLMN or an SNPN.

entities.name: UDM
entities.description: Unified Data Management function in a PLMN or SNPN that stores user subscription data including network slicing information.

relations.description: The network slicing indication IE is included when the user's network slicing subscription has changed in the UDM.
The subscription change condition is defined with respect to the UDM in a PLMN or SNPN.
